reason: Sixty days next to my Square setup with no contract and a loaned reader means I risk almost nothing, and having someone who knows salons stand at my desk on a Saturday is more than any card rep has offered. I'd try it, not switch right away.
objection: What happens when the internet goes down on a busy Saturday? Nothing here tells me it keeps taking tickets offline, and I won't risk my line of clients on that.
would_change_my_mind: Show me it keeps working with no internet on a real Saturday, with tickets saved and synced later, and let me talk to a salon owner who has had it go down.
